newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady, await FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady, await FOMC meeting.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds were little changed on Friday, with the market deadlocked by a possible U.S. interest rate hike on Tuesday, dealers said.
On May 20 the U.S. policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee meets and could raise U.S. interest rates.
"The market is completely dead waiting for the FOMC decision on the interest rates. Whatever opinions are, nothing would move until then," Eurobank dealer Olivier Coursault said.
MinFins with other emerging debt are sensitive to any news which would suggest a further rise in U.S. interest rates, as this would push down U.S. Treasury bond prices.
"Trading was otherwise quiet as the majority of banks are in a wait-and-see mood until Tuesday," Mosbiznesbank dealer Pavel Navolokin said.
